name: field
title: Field
description: Field, input, affix cells, field group and validation with an inserted attention cell. Form (Base UI Form) and vertical, horizontal or responsive field orientation.
whenToUse: Use it to give any input a label, description and error, and Form to line fields up. Reach for it around every text input in a form.

parts.name: FieldAffix
parts.description: A unit, currency or icon cell inside the frame.

parts.name: FieldBar
parts.description: A row across the frame's whole width, above (`side="start"`) or below (`side="end"`) the input row: a textarea's formatting toggles, its character count, a hint. Its children are cells. Buttons inside a frame are Button `layout="cell"` (size "icon" with an aria-label for icon-only); toggles are Toggle `layout="cell"`. They sit beside the input as cells and keep their own focus ring. A child with `data-kl-spacer` takes the room between.

parts.name: FieldControl
parts.description: The text input cell: Base UI's Field.Control. `align="end"` right-aligns a number with tabular figures.

parts.name: FieldDescription
parts.description: A line under the frame, read out with the control (Base UI ties it through aria-describedby).

parts.name: FieldError
parts.description: The field's error. With children it shows them (pair with `match` for a specific check). Without children it shows Base UI's own message: a `validate` result, a native constraint message, or a server error from Form `errors` for this field's name. Either way the attention glyph leads.

parts.name: FieldFrame
parts.description: The control frame: a row of cells (affixes, the control, buttons and toggles with `layout="cell"`, bars). The attention cell is inserted at its start and opens while the field is invalid. Its edge is the focus indicator. `layout="cell"`: the frame is a cell of an enclosing frame (no border or cut of its own).

parts.name: FieldGroup
parts.description: Several labelled inputs in ONE frame (e.g. L × W × H). Each part is a cell with its own label.

props.name: invalid
props.description: Marks the whole group invalid (e.g. a cross-field rule). Parts mark themselves with `invalid`.

props.name: legend
props.type: string | number | bigint | boolean | ReactElement<unknown, string | JSXElementConstructor<any>> | Iterable<ReactNode> | ReactPortal | Promise<AwaitedReactNode>

parts.name: FieldGroupError
parts.description: Error for a whole group (cross-field rules such as "height exceeds the trailer"). Announced politely.

parts.name: FieldGroupJoin
parts.description: The sign between two parts of a group (× by default). Hidden from assistive technology.

parts.name: FieldGroupPart
parts.description: One labelled cell of a FieldGroup: a Base UI Field.Root with its label and control. It takes the focus edge (a flush band on the group frame's keylines); the frame does not.

parts.name: FieldLabel
parts.description: Names the control; Base UI ties it to the control (`for`, or `aria-labelledby` for a non-native control).

parts.name: FieldMessages
parts.description: The description and error a single-control component (Select, Combobox, Slider, NumberField) prints under its frame. `error` with `invalid` always shows; `error` alone replaces Base UI's message whenever the field fails a check; no `error` shows Base UI's own (a `validate` result, a native constraint, or the Form's `errors` entry for the field's name). Must sit inside the component's Field.Root. With layout="cell" there is no room under the frame: the messages are visually hidden but still describe the control (the frame's red edge and ! cell are the visible signal).

props.name: description
props.type: string | number | bigint | boolean | ReactElement<unknown, string | JSXElementConstructor<any>> | Iterable<ReactNode> | ReactPortal | Promise<AwaitedReactNode>

props.name: error
props.type: string | number | bigint | boolean | ReactElement<unknown, string | JSXElementConstructor<any>> | Iterable<ReactNode> | ReactPortal | Promise<AwaitedReactNode>

parts.name: FieldRoot
parts.description: Base UI's Field.Root: label, frame, description and error, with Base UI's validation (invalid, validate, match). `orientation`: vertical (label above, the default), horizontal (label in a start column of --kl-form-label, everything else in the control column), responsive (horizontal while the enclosing Form, or any element with `container: kl-form / inline-size`, is at least 560px wide). Without it the field follows its Form's orientation. A field with layout="cell" never goes horizontal.

parts.name: FieldTextarea
parts.description: A multi-line control cell: Base UI's Field.Control rendering a <textarea>, resizable in height.

parts.name: Fieldset
parts.description: Base UI's Fieldset.Root: a group of fields under one legend, laid out as a field.

parts.name: FieldsetLegend
parts.description: Base UI's Fieldset.Legend, in the field label's voice.

parts.name: Form
parts.description: Base UI's Form (submit-time validation, server `errors` keyed by field name, `actionsRef`), laid out as a column of fields. It is the container the responsive orientation measures. While its fields are horizontal, FormActions sits in the control column, under the inputs; mark any other element (a row of checkboxes, a notice about one field) data-kl-span="control" to put it there too.

parts.name: FormActions
parts.description: The form's commit row: buttons in reading order, the commit action first.
